title: A strategy lead takes the interview further — 'Asking an AI to play the customer is just the newest way to avoid meeting one'
summary: Kedar advises organisations on strategy and product. Writing about the Itamar Gilad interview, he argues that a synthetic customer drifts toward the probable while a researcher can chase the outlier, so teams build faster on feedback that cannot tell them they are wrong.
blockquote: Asking an AI to play the customer is just the newest way to avoid meeting one.
